scene: The giant orange cat purrs loudly, rolling over to reveal glowing keys.
picture: A flat side-view pixel interior. On the far left, an ornate iron spiral staircase leads upward. In the centre, grandmother in her pink tracksuit pats the rolled-over giant orange cat while her white dog sniffs its tail, revealing three glowing brass keys on the cat's collar. On the right, a jade kettle steams atop the counter.
